title: Forward Air Controller/Air Officer (I) (Col to 2ndLt) FMOS, DC AVN
raw_text:
1. MOS 7502, Forward Air Controller/Air Officer (I) (Col to 2ndLt) FMOS, DC
AVN

    a. Summary. A Naval Aviator, Naval Flight Officer, or Unmanned Aircraft
Systems Officer serving as a JTAC assigned to a non-aviation unit. The FAC
is prepared to integrate all functions of aviation during the planning and
execution of ground operations and is prepared to conduct required liaison.

       b.    Prerequisites.     Must be a 75XX officer or UAS officer.

    c. Requirements. This MOS is to be assigned as a non-PMOS only to Naval
Aviators, Naval Flight Officers, and UAS Officers, upon completion of the
Amphibious Tactical Air Control Party Course (N306741) at NAB, Coronado, San
Diego, CA or (N036741) at NAB, Little Creek, VA.

       d.    Duties

        (1) Advises commanders of ground units on the suitability of targets
as objectives for aircraft, types of aircraft best suited for particular
missions, and on marking of targets and front-line positions.

        (2) Maintains liaison with Ground Intelligence Officers to obtain
information on enemy positions, location of targets, position of front lines,
and time aircraft are needed for strike.

        (3) Arranges air support missions by contacting aviation units and
giving number and type of aircraft needed, target information, armament
desired, and time of attack.

        (4) Directs and controls aircraft on a support mission by radio
communication from a forward position.

             (5) Observes and reports the results of strikes.

             (6) Coordinates all aviation assault support missions for ground
units.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Teachers and Instructors, All Other 25-3099.

       f.    Related Military Skill.     None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
